This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.

## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.8`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useVueRegisteredComponentNameCasing`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Inspired from [`vue/component-options-name-casing`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/component-options-name-casing)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useVueRegisteredComponentNameCasing": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce a consistent casing style for the names of components registered in the `components` option of Vue components.

A Vue component can make other components available to its template by listing them in
its `components` option. The name of each entry is the name the template uses for that
component. Using one naming style for all of these names makes components easier to find
and to use.

The naming style also decides how the template can refer to a component. A component
registered as `TodoItem` can be written as both `<TodoItem>` and `<todo-item>` in a
template. A component registered as `todo-item` can only be written as `<todo-item>`, and
a component registered as `todoItem` can't be written as `<TodoItem>`.

Names written only with characters from writing systems without uppercase and
lowercase letters, such as `漢字`, follow every style. Names that contain symbols, such as
`_` or `$`, don't follow any style.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<script>
export default {
  components: {
    todoItem: TodoItem,
  },
};
</script>
```

### Valid

```vue
<script>
export default {
  components: {
    TodoItem,
    TodoList: List,
  },
};
</script>
```

## Options

### `casing`

Default: `"PascalCase"`

The casing that component names must follow: `"PascalCase"`, `"camelCase"`, or
`"kebab-case"`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useVueRegisteredComponentNameCasing": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"casing": "kebab-case"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```vue
<script>
export default {
  components: {
    TodoItem,
  },
};
</script>
```
